extraction.Name: Frank Arcoren (Deceased); testimony by Josephine Arcoren
extraction.NOTES: Frank Arcoren is deceased; died in 1920. Testimony given by his mother, Josephine Arcoren, age 60, who states he was her son. Frank was divorced at the time he sold his land. He left no children. Josephine Arcoren has four dependents. She is in good health. Notary: Jas. W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-[year unclear].
